name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source IoT platform for device management, telemetry collection, rule-based processing and dashboards, backed by PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: The first start initializes the database and takes a few minutes. Then sign in as sysadmin@thingsboard.org with password sysadmin and change that password immediately.
Only the web UI and HTTP API are routed. Devices can send telemetry over the HTTP device API; MQTT, CoAP and LwM2M ports are not published.
